name: Beihang VIR
full_name: Beihang remote-controlled vascular interventional robot (VISR / VIR / RVIR / VIR-2) and its successor catheter operating robot (COR, 2016), the 2023 MIVI robot
group: Beihang University Robotics Institute (Tianmiao Wang, Da Liu; 2010 corresponding author Dapeng Zhang) and Image Processing Centre / School of Astronautics (Cai Meng); clinical: Department of Neurosurgery, Navy General Hospital of PLA (Wang-sheng Lu, Zeng-min Tian; author affiliation in lu2011 and lu2016); 2023 version Beijing Institute of Petrochemical Technology (Shaoya Guan, Limei Ma) with Cai Meng
versions: 2010 VISR: 5-DOF lockable passive hydraulic supporting arm + catheter navigator (rollers on a gear), PVDF tip sensor, Omega 6 master, glass model and 1 dog (wang2010_remote) -> 2011 VIR + virtual surgery training system, 10 beagles (lu2011_application) -> 2013 RVIR: image guidance (C-arm calibration, MicronTracker, catheter localisation, 3D reconstruction), Falcon master (meng2013_remote) -> VIR-2, 15 patients 2013 (lu2016_clinical, online 2015) -> 2016 COR, a new driver with bionic friction fingers, leadscrew rotation and a clamping motor, 2.6 kg, bench and glass model (meng2016_novel) -> 2023 MIVI robot with EM-tracked navigation (guan2023_multi; its Fig. 5(b) is the same photograph as meng2016 Fig. 5)
target_anatomy: cerebral (angiography in patients); renal, cardiac chambers, cerebrovascular arteries in animals; aortic (2023 navigation: AAA, TAA, AD data)
devices_driven: catheter only, one device: 1.5 mm catheters (wang2010_remote p. 200); 4F-6F (1.33-2.00 mm) single-bend catheters through a 6F sheath, guidewire not driven ('the medical robot controlled only the catheter', lu2011_application p. 363, 365); 5F single-curve catheter in patients (lu2016_clinical p. 133); COR: 4F catheter (meng2016_novel p. 307)
n_dof_detail: 2 active (axial: stepping motor 2; rotation: stepping motor 1) on a 5-DOF lockable passive hydraulic supporting arm (wang2010_remote p. 196); COR: translation, rotation and clamping motors (meng2016_novel p. 305)
translation_detail: friction-roller (catheter clamped by rollers 1 and 2 driven by stepping motor 2, wang2010_remote p. 196; COR / 2023 MIVI: bionic friction fingers, meng2016_novel p. 305, guan2023_multi Fig. 5a)
rotation_detail: the roller pair sits on a passive gear turned by stepping motor 1 through an active gear (wang2010_remote p. 196); COR: the two bionic fingers translate in opposite directions via a two-direction leadscrew and belt (finger rolling) (meng2016_novel p. 305); 2023: rotation motor (guan2023_multi Fig. 5a)
device_range: catheter speed 10-25 mm/s (wang2010_remote p. 199; lu2011_application p. 364); stroke N.R.; COR 205 pulses per mm (meng2016_novel p. 307)
mass_kg: COR 2.6 kg, aluminium alloy and steel (meng2016_novel p. 309); VIR N.R.
force_sensing: PVDF piezoelectric film glued at the catheter tip, robot stalls above a threshold (wang2010_remote p. 198); lu2011 calls the force feedback virtual (p. 365); not used in the 15 patients (lu2016_clinical p. 136); COR none
haptics_leader: Omega 6 haptic device (Force Dimension) (wang2010_remote p. 198); 3-DOF Novint Falcon in a shielded cabinet (meng2013_remote p. 231); master controlled over LAN, device N.R. (lu2016_clinical p. 133)
imaging_compat: X-ray/DSA (GE LCV+ C-arm); RVIR image guidance with an H40 MicronTracker and C-arm calibration phantom (meng2013_remote p. 231-236); 2023: EM tracking + CTA-DSA 2D/3D registration
validation_detail: 15 patients (March-September 2013), robot-assisted cerebral angiography, femoral sheath placed by hand, no complications (lu2016_clinical p. 133-134); 10 beagles (16-20 kg), 9 targets including both carotid and both vertebral arteries, 5 repeats, no complications (lu2011_application p. 363; meng2013_remote '10 dogs'); 1 dog, 5 targets, and glass model with 10 repeats per speed (wang2010_remote); COR: bench (10 trials per length 10-50 mm, 10 rotations) and glass model (meng2016_novel); 2023 vascular model only (guan2023_multi)
key_numbers: remote positioning accuracy 1.05 +/- 0.28 mm; staff DSA exposure 0 min; procedure 25-41 min, mean 34.4 +/- 5.13 min (lu2016_clinical p. 134); catheter motion error < 0.5 mm in a glass model (wang2010_remote p. 199); distortion correction RMS 0.35 px, distance reconstruction RMS 0.53 mm (max 1.34 mm) (meng2013_remote); COR axial accuracy -0.04 to 0.34 mm, relative error within +-5% (meng2016_novel Table I); 2023: 2D/3D registration < 1 mm, EM positioning RMS < 1 mm and max < 2 mm over 4 paths x 26 points (guan2023_multi Results, Fig. 7)
sim_model: virtual surgery training system (lu2011_application abstract); no controller-training model
